name: Natsu Ecchi 2 ~Futago to Inaka no Natsuyasumi~
original_name: なつえっち２～ふたごといなかのなつやすみ～
source: This summer I was asked to watch after my twin nieces. One of the sisters, Mai, is interested in sex. As we are starting to get intimate I need to keep this a secret from her sister Satsuki.
translation: 今年夏天，我被要求照顾我的双胞胎侄女。其中一位姐妹麦对性感兴趣。当我们开始变得亲密时，我需要对她的姐姐小月保密。
